about_the_game:
In a cozy, soft nest, in the heart of a wood and stone labyrinth, a clockwork mouse sleeps & dreams of the outside world. As it wakes & ventures forth, the mouse will need to make full use of its clever mind & keen senses. The maze will be challenging to navigate, doors leading further on are locked by mysterious puzzles, & unknown dangers may await. The mouse holds onto hope that, despite its past experiences, this time it will achieve its goal: Escape.

Éalú is a point & click puzzle/adventure game where the player:

  • Guides the mouse through a maze, starting from the center.

  • Finds clues & solves puzzles & has dangerous encounters.

  • Eats cheese!

  • Discovers the true nature of the maze &, ultimately, how to escape.

Lovingly made by a tiny team

This is a true stop-motion game, where everything was hand-animated & the mouse was photographed in place next to physical sets & props. Over 450 video clips were painstakingly created by one animator (mostly in a garden shed) & then woven together in the Unity game engine by one developer to create this interactive experience. Original music was composed & recorded by a single person specifically for the score of the game, & beautiful drawings were created from scratch by our illustrator.

Éalú was made with literally no budget & no crowdfunding, by just 4 people passionate about the project:

  • Ivan Owen of Beyond the Bark- Game concept, design, animation & writing

  • Benjamin Orr- Game design, Unity development & writing

  • Will Wood- Musical composition & writing

  • JT Paton- Original illustrations & promotional art

Our hope is that you enjoy this interactive experience as much as we all enjoyed making it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 4-core (8 CPUs), ~3.6GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated chipset
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 4-core (8 CPUs), ~3.6GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX550, 2GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Éalú is an entirely hand-animated, stop-motion, point & click adventure game where you guide a wooden mouse through a maze, encountering puzzles, cheese and unknown dangers as you search for a way out.
